repository.note: VIPM is configured by default with two public repositories, VIPM Community and the NI LabVIEW Tools Network, which can be read without authentication. Users can add other repositories.

name_definition.note: The name is the VIPM package name (e.g. oglib_file). It is not case sensitive and shall be lowercased.

version_definition.note: The version is the package version, including the release suffix when there is one (e.g. 6.0.2.28, 5.0.9-1).
